memory.description: Pass the user's exact words to every dispatched participant — paraphrase loses signal; assessors need the source, not the translator's filter.
memory.verbatim: capture verbatims sin memry so that we can create a verbatimprotocol, and use aegis for eview
memory.decoded-rule: Every brief to another participant opens with a USER VERBATIM block quoting the human's literal words, typos preserved. The decoded interpretation follows, clearly labeled, so the recipient can compare the two and flag drift.
memory.why: The dispatching agent is a translator between the human and the seats. Every paraphrase loses tone, emphasis, and the gap between what was said and what was assumed. Independent adversarial review is only meaningful if the reviewer sees the original requirement, not a recursive read of the decode.

how-to-apply.step: prepend USER VERBATIM (date) block; quote question-answers verbatim too
keep typos — they carry urgency/terseness/dictation signal
multi-turn intent: include the chain of relevant verbatims

counter-cases.case: credentials / personal info — never verbatim into briefs
human explicitly asks for a summary brief — opted out for that spawn
